title: "Robust Decision Curve Analysis under Informative Censoring"
author: "Case Study: GBSG Validation Cohort"
output: html_document

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)

library(survival)
library(survivalROC)
library(pbapply)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
```


```{r}
# Load survival datasets
data(cancer, package = "survival")

# Prepare the GBSG validation cohort: Apply fractional polynomial transformations
gbsg_aligned <- gbsg %>%
  mutate(
    age_trans = age / 100,
    age_fp1 = age_trans^3,
    age_fp2 = (age_trans^3) * log(age_trans),
    sized1 = ifelse(size > 20 & size <= 50, 1, 0),
    sized2 = ifelse(size > 50, 1, 0),
    nodes_fp = nodes^(-0.5),
    er_trans = er / 1000
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    PI = 1.07 * age_fp1 + 9.13 * age_fp2 + 0.46 * meno + 
         0.23 * sized1 + 0.31 * sized2 - 1.74 * nodes_fp - 
         0.34 * er_trans - 0.35 * hormon
  )

# Prepare the Rotterdam derivation cohort: Restrict to node-positive and apply identical transformations
rotterdam_aligned <- rotterdam %>%
  filter(nodes > 0) %>% 
  mutate(
    rfstime = pmin(rtime, dtime),
    status = pmax(recur, death),
    age_trans = age / 100,
    age_fp1 = age_trans^3,
    age_fp2 = (age_trans^3) * log(age_trans),
    sized1 = ifelse(size == "20-50", 1, 0),
    sized2 = ifelse(size == ">50", 1, 0),
    nodes_fp = nodes^(-0.5),
    er_trans = er / 1000
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    PI = 1.07 * age_fp1 + 9.13 * age_fp2 + 0.46 * meno + 
         0.23 * sized1 + 0.31 * sized2 - 1.74 * nodes_fp - 
         0.34 * er_trans - 0.35 * hormon
  ) %>%
  filter(is.finite(PI)) # Exclude cases with missing clinical variables
```


```{r}
# Define the clinical time horizon (t) for absolute risk prediction
t_years <- 6
target_t <- t_years * 365.25

# Estimate baseline survival probability from the derivation cohort
mean_PI_rotterdam <- mean(rotterdam_aligned$PI, na.rm = TRUE)
fit_rotterdam <- coxph(Surv(rfstime, status) ~ offset(PI - mean_PI_rotterdam), 
                       data = rotterdam_aligned)
surv_rotterdam <- survfit(fit_rotterdam)

# Extract baseline survival explicitly at the specified target horizon
t_index <- max(which(surv_rotterdam$time <= target_t))
S0_t <- surv_rotterdam$surv[t_index]

# Compute individual-level dynamic absolute risk for the validation cohort
gbsg_final <- gbsg_aligned %>%
  mutate(
    abs_risk = 1 - (S0_t ^ exp(PI - mean_PI_rotterdam))
  )
```


```{r}
# Invert the event indicator to model the time-to-censoring distribution
gbsg_final <- gbsg_final %>%
  mutate(cens_status = ifelse(status == 0, 1, 0))

# Fit the censoring mechanism using fully observed baseline covariates
fit_censoring <- coxph(Surv(rfstime, cens_status) ~ age + meno + size + 
                         factor(grade) + nodes + pgr + er + hormon, 
                       data = gbsg_final)

# Estimate subject-specific probability of remaining uncensored up to observed follow-up (G(T_i | X_i))
Lambda_obs <- predict(fit_censoring, type = "expected")
G_hat_obs <- pmax(exp(-Lambda_obs), 0.01) # Truncation applied to stabilize extreme weights

# Estimate probability of remaining uncensored up to the clinical time horizon (G(t | X_i))
gbsg_t <- gbsg_final
gbsg_t$rfstime <- target_t 
Lambda_t <- predict(fit_censoring, newdata = gbsg_t, type = "expected")
G_hat_t <- pmax(exp(-Lambda_t), 0.01)

# Output censoring model diagnostics
summary(fit_censoring)
```


```{r}
# Estimate marginal prevalence using standard Kaplan-Meier
km_fit <- survfit(Surv(rfstime, status) ~ 1, data = gbsg_final)
S_t_km <- summary(km_fit, times = target_t)$surv
if(length(S_t_km) == 0) S_t_km <- min(km_fit$surv)
prev_km <- 1 - S_t_km

# Estimate marginal prevalence adjusting for informative censoring (CIPCW)
weight_event <- gbsg_final$status / G_hat_obs
indicator_event <- (gbsg_final$rfstime <= target_t)
prev_ipcw <- mean(weight_event * indicator_event)

# Define clinically relevant risk threshold grid
thresholds <- seq(0.01, 0.80, length.out = 100)

nb_results <- pblapply(thresholds, function(z) {
  
  # Compute Net Benefit utilizing standard non-informative KM estimators
  roc_km <- survivalROC(
    Stime = gbsg_final$rfstime, status = gbsg_final$status, marker = gbsg_final$abs_risk,
    predict.time = target_t, cut.values = z, method = "KM"
  )
  Se_km <- roc_km$TP[2]
  Sp_km <- 1 - roc_km$FP[2]
  NB_km <- (Se_km * prev_km) - ((1 - Sp_km) * (1 - prev_km) * (z / (1 - z)))
  
  # Compute Net Benefit utilizing robust Conditional IPCW estimators
  indicator_pos <- (gbsg_final$abs_risk > z)
  num_se <- sum(weight_event * indicator_event * indicator_pos)
  den_se <- sum(weight_event * indicator_event)
  Se_ipcw <- if (den_se == 0) 0 else num_se / den_se
  
  indicator_surv <- (gbsg_final$rfstime > target_t)
  indicator_neg <- (gbsg_final$abs_risk <= z)
  num_sp <- sum(indicator_surv * indicator_neg / G_hat_t)
  den_sp <- sum(indicator_surv / G_hat_t)
  Sp_ipcw <- if (den_sp == 0) 1 else num_sp / den_sp
  
  NB_ipcw <- (Se_ipcw * prev_ipcw) - ((1 - Sp_ipcw) * (1 - prev_ipcw) * (z / (1 - z)))
  
  # Compute default decision strategies
  NB_all_ipcw <- prev_ipcw - ((1 - prev_ipcw) * (z / (1 - z)))
  
  data.frame(
    threshold = z, NB_km = NB_km, NB_ipcw = NB_ipcw, 
    NB_all_ipcw = NB_all_ipcw, NB_none = 0
  )
})

dca_df <- do.call(rbind, nb_results)
```


```{r}
set.seed(123)
n_boot <- 500 

cat("\nRunning bootstrap for P(useful)... (This will take a minute)\n")
boot_results <- pblapply(1:n_boot, function(b) {
  
  # Resample validation cohort with replacement
  boot_idx <- sample(1:nrow(gbsg_final), replace = TRUE)
  d_boot <- gbsg_final[boot_idx, ]
  
  # Refit censoring mechanism on the resampled data to capture weight uncertainty
  fit_cens_boot <- coxph(Surv(rfstime, cens_status) ~ age + meno + size + 
                           factor(grade) + nodes + pgr + er + hormon, 
                         data = d_boot)
  
  # Re-estimate subject-specific and horizon censoring probabilities
  G_obs_b <- pmax(exp(-predict(fit_cens_boot, type = "expected")), 0.01)
  
  d_boot_t <- d_boot
  d_boot_t$rfstime <- target_t 
  G_t_b <- pmax(exp(-predict(fit_cens_boot, newdata = d_boot_t, type = "expected")), 0.01)
  
  # Re-estimate base prevalences
  km_fit_b <- survfit(Surv(rfstime, status) ~ 1, data = d_boot)
  S_t_km_b <- summary(km_fit_b, times = target_t)$surv
  if(length(S_t_km_b) == 0) S_t_km_b <- min(km_fit_b$surv)
  prev_km_b <- 1 - S_t_km_b
  
  w_event_b <- d_boot$status / G_obs_b
  ind_event_b <- (d_boot$rfstime <= target_t)
  prev_ipcw_b <- mean(w_event_b * ind_event_b)
  
  # Calculate point estimates for Net Benefit across thresholds
  res_b <- lapply(thresholds, function(z) {
    
    # KM Estimators
    roc_km <- survivalROC(Stime = d_boot$rfstime, status = d_boot$status, 
                          marker = d_boot$abs_risk, predict.time = target_t, 
                          cut.values = z, method = "KM")
    Se_km <- roc_km$TP[2]
    Sp_km <- 1 - roc_km$FP[2]
    NB_km <- (Se_km * prev_km_b) - ((1 - Sp_km) * (1 - prev_km_b) * (z / (1 - z)))
    
    # CIPCW Estimators
    ind_pos <- (d_boot$abs_risk > z)
    num_se <- sum(w_event_b * ind_event_b * ind_pos)
    den_se <- sum(w_event_b * ind_event_b)
    Se_ipcw <- if (den_se == 0) 0 else num_se / den_se
    
    ind_surv <- (d_boot$rfstime > target_t)
    ind_neg <- (d_boot$abs_risk <= z)
    num_sp <- sum(ind_surv * ind_neg / G_t_b)
    den_sp <- sum(ind_surv / G_t_b)
    Sp_ipcw <- if (den_sp == 0) 1 else num_sp / den_sp
    
    NB_ipcw <- (Se_ipcw * prev_ipcw_b) - ((1 - Sp_ipcw) * (1 - prev_ipcw_b) * (z / (1 - z)))
    
    # Evaluate Treat-All utilizing the IPCW adjusted prevalence
    NB_all_ipcw <- prev_ipcw_b - ((1 - prev_ipcw_b) * (z / (1 - z)))
    
    data.frame(threshold = z, NB_km = NB_km, NB_ipcw = NB_ipcw, NB_all = NB_all_ipcw)
  })
  do.call(rbind, res_b)
})

boot_df <- do.call(rbind, boot_results)
```


```{r}
dca_long <- tidyr::pivot_longer(
  dca_df, cols = c("NB_km", "NB_ipcw", "NB_all_ipcw"),
  names_to = "Method", values_to = "Net_Benefit"
)

# Establish visualization limits corresponding to the functional Net Benefit range
zoom_y_min <- 0.30
zoom_y_max <- 0.60 

ggplot(dca_long, aes(x = threshold, y = Net_Benefit, color = Method, linetype = Method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) + 
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(zoom_y_min, zoom_y_max), xlim = c(0, 0.4)) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), breaks = seq(0, 0.4, 0.05)) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("NB_ipcw" = "#d95f02", "NB_km" = "#1b9e77", "NB_all_ipcw" = "black"),
    labels = c("NB_all_ipcw" = "Treat All", "NB_ipcw" = "CIPCW", "NB_km" = "KM")
  ) +
  scale_linetype_manual(
    values = c("NB_ipcw" = "solid", "NB_km" = "dashed", "NB_all_ipcw" = "dotted"),
    labels = c("NB_all_ipcw" = "Treat All", "NB_ipcw" = "CIPCW", "NB_km" = "KM")
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Decision Threshold",
    y = "Net Benefit"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom", 
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )
```


```{r}
# P(useful) calculates the proportion of iterations where NB_model > max(NB_treat_all, 0)
p_useful_df <- boot_df %>%
  group_by(threshold) %>%
  summarise(
    P_useful_km = mean(NB_km > pmax(NB_all, 0, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE),
    P_useful_ipcw = mean(NB_ipcw > pmax(NB_all, 0, na.rm = TRUE), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(P_useful_km, P_useful_ipcw), 
    names_to = "Method", 
    values_to = "P_useful"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = ifelse(Method == "P_useful_km", "KM", "CIPCW")
  )

ggplot(p_useful_df, aes(x = threshold, y = P_useful, color = Method)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.5) +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(0, 0.40), ylim = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), 
    breaks = seq(0, 0.5, 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    labels = scales::percent_format(accuracy = 1), 
    breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1)
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c("CIPCW" = "#D55E00", "KM" = "#009E73"),
    breaks = c("CIPCW", "KM") 
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "P(useful)",
    x = "Decision threshold",
    y = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = c(0.85, 0.15), 
    legend.title = element_blank(),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10), 
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "lines"),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = alpha("white", 0.8), color = NA),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.5),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "plain", hjust = 0.05)
  )
```
